objective: Test whether genuinely trained differentiable episodic write/read gating learns which earlier public observations to retrieve at delayed query, improves against frozen-routing and erasure controls, and survives conventional cost/accuracy comparison.
claim_boundary: PUBLIC synthetic supervised memory routing, NOT discovered universal architecture, transfer or Q21 first use.

new_source.A_ONE_CUE_RECALL: o0 fair public bit; q in {10,18}; all other public bits iid fair; action q =2; target next o at q = o0 XOR Bernoulli(.05); previous action at q-1 iid binary.
new_source.B_SELECT_TWO_CUES: o0 first fair public cue; observation o4 second fair public cue supplied via next observation at t3; query at q in {10,18} action=2; action at q-1 is selector 0 or 1 and target query bit equals first cue for 0, second cue for 1 XOR Bernoulli(.05); all other observations iid fair.
new_source.C_CUE_ACTION_PARITY: o0 fair public cue; every prequery action 0/1 fair and public; query action 2; target query bit equals o0 XOR parity of prequery action 1 XOR Bernoulli(.05); rest observations iid fair.
new_source.NULL_IID_QUERY: query timings/action distribution identical; query next public bit iid fair, initial o0 fair, other public bits iid fair. No systematic target dependence on public history.

learner_information: Sequence o_t,a_t (action=2 indicates query), t/T and t==0,t==4 publicly observable. B selector is publicly observable action at q-1. No source-family identifier, hidden label, next target or role is supplied as learner feature. All train/query supervision occurs exclusively on O9_PUBLIC_TRAIN query target; SELECT only for restart selection.

models.LEARNED_WRITE_READ: Differentiable external episodic store one public event per prequery timestep; per-event 7-d feature [1,o_t,action0,action1,is_t0,is_t4,t/24]. Train 7 write-logit weights, 7 base read-score weights, 7 query-selector interaction read-score weights, and 3 sigmoid output weights (bias, read value-0.5, selector) with exact per-query gradient and Adam. write sigmoid and read softmax over public events t<=q. 40 epochs, per-example Adam lr=.03, clipping norm2, two independent starts 17,31, restart chosen on SELECT. Query selector=action at q-1; baseline and targets never fed in features.
models.LEARNED_READ_FIXED_WRITE: Same architecture and training but write-mask fixed=1 for all events; train only read and output weights. Same training budget and starts.
models.FROZEN_RANDOM_ROUTE: Same event memory; fixed random write and read parameters from respective seed; only three query output weights trained at same epochs/lr; compare learning routes against frozen route.
models.ERASED_LEARNED_HISTORY: No training/selection of own. Reuse exact selected LEARNED_WRITE_READ checkpoint but erase all prequery events before query (only public current query event remains).
models.O8_GATED4_FROZEN_CODE: Byte-identical original O8 gated recurrence from O8 source blob 6f0e9d58718efdae0e448e9387d325cf653a81fc. Fit fresh O9_PUBLIC_TRAIN with original 12 epochs 0.01 Adam and independent starts17/31 selected SELECT.
models.PUBLIC_EPISODIC_TABLE: Fully fitted Laplace+1 counts; on A key o0, B key (o0,o4,selector), C key (o0,action_parity), NULL key (o0,action_parity). All are explicitly engineered from PUBLIC history; ability witness not capacity match.
models.CURRENT_QUERY_COUNTS: Fully fitted Laplace+1 counts keyed (current o at query, query delay), no earlier memory.
models.UNIFORM_NULL: Fixed p=0.5 next bit, no training, NULL behavior diagnostic.

frozen_hyperparams.selection: minimum public SELECT query-only NLL by start with lowest seed tie break

evaluation.primary: PUBLIC_DEV query-only next-bit mean NLL, lower better, for all eight arms all four families
evaluation.causal_state_ablation: ERASED_LEARNED_HISTORY DEV NLL minus LEARNED_WRITE_READ DEV NLL; positive supports contribution of retrieved prequery history, NOT independently learned generalization.
evaluation.routing_ablation: FROZEN_RANDOM_ROUTE and LEARNED_READ_FIXED_WRITE vs LEARNED_WRITE_READ; all have identical public information; differing trainable parameter budget explicit.
evaluation.info_witness: PUBLIC_EPISODIC_TABLE trained on PUBLIC cue or parity history; not same parameter count/feature extractor.
evaluation.strong_baseline: O8_GATED4_FROZEN_CODE retrained on identical O9 training source identities; trained cost per full two restarts measured.
evaluation.bias_checks: NULL IID must be reported without fabricated positive; disclose correlation that can arise by chance in finite DEV.
evaluation.resource: record full learning model checkpoint including optimizer state, inferred parameters, fit+SELECT CPU, DEV CPU, source generation CPU, process CPU and peak RSS/tracemalloc.
evaluation.cross_os: All 12 family×role source digests identical across Windows and Linux; all 32 family×arm DEV NLL outputs agree within 1e-6.
evaluation.standards: No selection on DEV, no post-DEV retuning/replaying same frozen identity, record all signed gains even negative; no scientific GO from PUBLIC DEV.

guardrails: No FSA, original Q21/Q21N01, HELD, native Wingless/Yggdrasil, KTRADE, broker or controller changes.
No paid API or extra scheduler/queue; GitHub hosted native Windows/Linux development only.
Source-only additive draft PR and exact ancestry/immutable protocol blob.
Do not merge on synthetic DEV findings, and do not treat engineered event positions as spontaneously learned representations.
No hidden generator state or source-family key given to learners; all models see identical public trajectories.
